complete.title: Complete transfer
complete.description: The items leave the source warehouse and arrive in the destination. Stock held for orders never moves; if a line is short, nothing moves.

cancel.title: Cancel transfer
cancel.description: The transfer is closed without moving any stock.

apply.title: Apply count
apply.description: On-hand is set to what was counted for every counted line, with a stock adjustment for each difference.

cancel.title: Cancel count
cancel.description: The count is closed without changing any stock.
